architecture.dispersion: NB2, alpha by deterministic bounded ML on log alpha in [1e-6,20] with mu fixed, training rows only; Var=mu+alpha*mu^2
architecture.hyperparameter_freeze: alpha=0.001 comes from V1 development folds on 2018-2023 targets; no re-tuning on any season
architecture.mean_model: sklearn PoissonRegressor(alpha=0.001,max_iter=1000,tol=1e-6) on ALL candidate rows (non-participants have SOG 0)
architecture.preprocessing: training-only median imputation + explicit missing indicator per continuous feature + training-only standardisation; TEAM_REST_HOURS capped at 240 for regression input only; binary features: POS_F,POS_D,POS_UNKNOWN,IS_HOME,BACK_TO_BACK,PLAYED_LAST1
architecture.support: 0..K, K extended until survival<1e-10, ceiling 200 (survival>=1e-10 at 200 invalidates the distribution)

availability_layer.rule: a source/horizon may influence forecasts only after the capture-integrity gate in phase1a_sog_forward_protocol.json passes; until then it is recorded, never used
availability_layer.separation: WHO is expected to play is separate from HOW MANY shots if available

commit_order: first forward forecasts (windows still open only)

comparators.count_distribution_for_baselines: Poisson with the baseline mean (Phase0 locked dispersion index 1.107 <= 1.15)
frozen_before_results: Phase0 simple central baseline (formula: prior-10 same-season appearance mean; also season rate x prior-3 TOI, prior-3, prior-5, EWMA 0.2 reported)
Phase0 competent-human baseline (formula frozen in phase0 protocol amendment 2, constants re-estimated on FIT 2018-2022 MEANINGFUL rows of the V2 data)
current production SOG>=3 classifier (binary comparison only, from phase0_error_receipts p_served)
comparators.identical_rows: every comparison is on the intersection of rows for which all compared forecasts exist; production classifier comparison is on rows that played (it has no rows otherwise) and favours the classifier because B2 mixes participation

evidence_standing.first_clean_confirmation: forward 2026 forecasts created AFTER the engine lock commit is pushed

firewall.tests: tests/test_nhl_v2_phase1a_sog.py scans nhl_v2_phase1a_sog_*.py for the banned tokens in phase0 protocol.json

fit_rules.burned_reproduction: fit targets 2018-2024 at T90, score 2025 (same as V1)
fit_rules.forward_engine: fit targets 2018-2025 per horizon; coefficients, dispersion, preprocessing frozen at the engine lock; NO refit during the forward window
fit_rules.forward_history: completed 2026 games may update rolling player/team history features because they are available at forecast time; they never alter coefficients

forecast_horizons.model_per_horizon: the same fixed B2 architecture is fit once per horizon on training rows built with that horizon's cutoff; T90 equals the V1 reference and is the reproduction target
forecast_horizons.source_game_rule: a source game is usable iff start+210 min <= cutoff and it is not the target game

large_miss_forensics.rule: a class is assigned only where the diagnostic exceeds a fixed ratio (actual/predicted TOI>=1.25 or <=0.75; realised/predicted rate>=1.5 or <=0.5; team SOG actual/predicted>=1.25 or <=0.75; not played or played with TOI<predicted*0.5 => AVAILABILITY; actual PP TOI >= 2x history and >=120 s => PP_DEPLOYMENT); two or more => MULTIPLE; none => UNRESOLVED; postgame values are diagnostics only

ledgers.CLEAN: may censor only documented abnormal exits (in-game injury with abnormal lost ice time, ejection/misconduct); never poor shooting, ordinary benching, demotion, score effects or coaching decisions; a censor needs a documented reason in the grader record

thresholds_1_to_5: Brier skill vs frozen base-rate comparator (FIT-period event rate by position)
metrics.uncertainty: 2-calendar-week moving-block bootstrap on game-level CRPS differences, 10000 reps, seed 20261002 (V1 procedure)

no_simulation: no Monte Carlo; the NB2 distribution provides uncertainty

populations.FULL_PREGAME_CANDIDATE_UNIVERSE: players who appeared for the team in its last 10 usable prior team games (V1 universe)

MEANINGFUL_EXPECTED_PARTICIPANT_UNIVERSE.rule: candidate AND PLAY_DEN_TG10>=5 AND PLAY_RATE_TG10>=0.6 AND TEAM_GAMES_SINCE_APPEARANCE<=1 AND TOI_MEAN_CT_APP3>=480 (seconds)
MEANINGFUL_EXPECTED_PARTICIPANT_UNIVERSE.uses: prior information only; never target-game appearance or TOI

populations.diagnostic_secondary: rows that actually played (conditional on playing) - postgame filter, descriptive only
populations.unobservable: target participants absent from the candidate set (call-ups, trades, debuts) are counted with player and SOG coverage and never inserted from target truth

reproduction_criterion.REPRODUCED_if: same row count and |dCRPS|<=1e-4 and |dNLL|<=1e-4 and |dMAE|<=1e-4
reproduction_criterion.label: BURNED_REPRODUCTION_ONLY
reproduction_criterion.otherwise: NOT_REPRODUCED is reported with the differences; no tuning to force agreement

target.outcome: shots on goal, regular season, shootout excluded (official stats-REST skater summary 'shots')
target.output: discrete SOG distribution; threshold probabilities are derived products only
